stem: Voltmarkt's commercial director asks: "Across all TV sales last quarter, what percentage off list price did customers get on their receipts?" Which calculation answers this question?

options.text: 100 × (1 - TV net revenue / TV list value)
100 × TV pocket value after rebates / TV list value
100 × (TV net revenue - TV cost) / TV net revenue
100 × clearance markdown euros / TV net sales
